question: Capital market is a market for ________ funds.

options.text: both short term and long term

solution:
The correct answer is __**long term**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The capital market is primarily focused on **long-term investments**.
 
• It facilitates the **buying and selling** of long-term financial instruments such as stocks, bonds, and other securities.
 
• Institutions like **stock exchanges** and **bond markets** are integral parts of the capital market.
 
• The capital market helps in the **allocation of resources** and **economic growth** by channeling savings into productive investments.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Primary Market:**

 
 
• Deals with the issuance of new securities directly from the issuers to investors.
 
• Includes Initial Public Offerings (IPOs) and private placements.
 
 
 
• **Secondary Market:**
 
 
• Involves the trading of existing securities among investors.
 
• Includes stock exchanges where securities are bought and sold.
 
 
 
• **Equity Market:**
 
 
• Part of the capital market where shares are issued and traded.
 
• It is also known as the stock market.
 
 
 
• **Debt Market:**
 
 
• Part of the capital market where debt instruments like bonds are traded.
 
• It helps in raising funds for governments and corporations.
 
 
 
• **Regulatory Bodies:**
 
 
• Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) regulates the capital markets in India.
 
• Ensures transparency, fairness, and investor protection.
